title: Dashboard-to-Deck Narrative Generator
description: Pick a sample dashboard PDF, watch Claude write the executive narrative, get a polished PPTX-ready deck. The other half of the BI workflow — turning visuals back into story.

resumeBullet.text: Built a Dashboard-to-Deck Narrative Generator on Next.js + Vercel — consumes sample BI dashboards, streams an AI-authored executive narrative explaining what the data means, and emits a polished PPTX-ready deck. Closes the loop on the BI workflow: dashboards out, stories back in.

portfolioCard.problem: Once a BI engineer ships a dashboard, the analyst's real work begins: writing the executive readout. Pulling the headline insight, drafting the bullet narrative, formatting a PPTX that survives the Monday review. This is the part nobody outsources well — vendor narrative tools generate generic captions, manual writing eats hours per week, and the dashboard-to-deck handoff is where insight quality gets lost.
portfolioCard.approach: Two-step factory mirroring the Project 1 pattern. (1) Pick a sample dashboard from a curated library, watch Claude stream the executive narrative live — hero metric, week-over-week movement, the contextual one-liner that explains why it matters. (2) Get a polished slide deck themed to the same design system, ready to download as PPTX or hand off to a designer. Same shared streaming primitive as Project 1, different output medium.
portfolioCard.impact: Analyst readout-writing time drops from hours to minutes. Narrative quality stays consistent because the AI works off the same hand-curated voice as Project 1's profiling fixtures. The deck is themed, accessible, and matches the company's design system out of the box — no separate template wrangling. See the case study (coming with v1.0) for architecture and engineering decisions.
